title: Agents That Model Agents: Five Principles Toward a Theory of Mind for 6G Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.01779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Future 6G networks will rely on Large Language Model (LLM) agents to manage the Radio Access Network (RAN). However, current architectures assume inter-agent messages convey objective facts. A message is instead a \emph{trace} of the sender's reasoning: it carries a subjective conclusion, so a syntactically valid report can propagate an AI hallucination and trigger a cascading outage invisible to protocol validation. Reading such a trace requires a Theory of Mind (ToM)---before acting, the receiver must model what the peer believes, and what a peer in that position should have believed. Modeling these interactions as cognitive channels on a cellular sheaf, we obtain a unified framework for resilient multi-agent systems, from which five design principles emerge: (i) a message is evidence of the sender's hidden reasoning; (ii) trust is a continuous cognitive Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)---asserted precision over deviation from the modeled

translated_title: 建模智能体的智能体：迈向6G网络心智理论的五大原则
translated_abstract: 未来的6G网络将依赖大语言模型（LLM）智能体来管理无线接入网（RAN）。然而，现有架构假设智能体间传递的消息承载的是客观事实。实际上，消息是发送方推理过程的“痕迹”：它承载的是主观结论，因此一份语法上有效的报告可能传播AI幻觉，并引发协议验证无法察觉的级联故障。解读这种痕迹需要心智理论——接收方在行动之前，必须建模对方相信什么，以及处于该位置的对方应当相信什么。通过将这些交互建模为胞腔层上的认知信道，我们获得了弹性多智能体系统的统一框架，并由此得出五项设计原则：（i）消息是发送方隐藏推理的证据；（ii）信任是连续的认知信噪比（SNR）——即声明精度相对于对建模的偏差……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文指出智能体间消息实为发送方主观推理的痕迹而非客观事实，通过将其建模为胞腔层上的认知信道并引入心智理论，为6G网络的LLM智能体系统建立了可抵御AI幻觉级联故障的弹性统一框架，并提出五项设计原则。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that inter-agent messages are traces of the sender's subjective reasoning rather than objective facts, and by modeling interactions as cognitive channels on a cellular sheaf with Theory of Mind, it establishes a unified framework with five design principles for resilient LLM-agent systems in 6G networks that can withstand cascading outages caused by AI hallucinations.
